As-built statement (baseline b4c5024): Each command carries an idempotency key and is de-duplicated on enqueue.

Replay is sequential and dependency-aware. A network error pauses the drain; after 25 automatic retries a command parks as FAILED for a manual retry. HTTP 409 marks CONFLICT; any other error marks FAILED. FAILED and CONFLICT commands older than 7 days are dropped; PENDING commands are never evicted automatically. There is no automatic conflict merge.
Note: The user retries or discards conflicts.

As-built statement (baseline b4c5024): Local cache and the outbox are stored as JSON strings in SharedPreferences (no SQLite). Evidence photos are copied into the app documents folder so a queued upload keeps its file.
Note: Large queues grow one preferences blob. Not tested at scale.

As-built statement (baseline b4c5024): No geo-tagging: the manifest requests no location permission and no location package is used.
No push notifications. The Notifications screen is derived on the device from the Job Work list; the backend has no notification service.

No background-task or connectivity-listener package is used. The queue drains while the app runs: right after a command is queued, when a session becomes available (login or restore), when the app returns to the foreground, when the user retries, and when the user taps the sync badge. Nothing drains the queue while the app is closed or in the background.
Note: Queued work is safe on the device but is not sent until the technician opens the app again. Owner to decide if that is acceptable for v1. Held: owner has not decided whether drain-only-while-open is acceptable for v1.
